intro.description:
You have unlocked the official Haunted Sweden investigation archive.

This archive contains historical research, photographs, maps, timelines and references that did not fit inside the printed book.
intro.descriptionSv:
Du har låst upp det officiella Haunted Sweden-utredningsarkivet.

Arkivet innehåller historisk research, fotografier, kartor, tidslinjer och referenser som inte fick plats i den tryckta boken.
principles: Like the book itself we always separate:
We never present folklore as verified history.
principlesSv: Precis som i boken skiljer vi alltid på:
Vi presenterar aldrig folklore som verifierad historia.
